snippet.title: By Bait or By Bullet | TRAILER | Coming Soon
snippet.description:
By Hook or By Crook is a bombastic 2D fishing rogue-lite adventure with both story-rich top-down exploration and action-packed platforming combat. 

Converse with the curious collection of characters who have been dragged beyond reality as you gear up for your next tentacular tussle. Play a fishing minigame to buoy your battling power and collect fish from the strangest ocean this side of nonexistence. Dive into battle against 3 fearsome limbs of a great interdimensional octopus! 

By Small Pond Studios
